facts.business: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Limited manufactures and exports fine jewellery including diamond, gold, gemstone, jadau and lab-grown diamond jewellery, and is expanding into the domestic market through a new manufacturing facility.

capacity_or_capex.item: New manufacturing facility at Andheri, Mumbai for domestic market

key_risks: Impact of Tariffs on Jewellery Trade to the USA from India
Fluctuations in gold and diamond prices
facts.related_party_note: All contracts executed by the Company during the financial year with related parties were under the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. The Company has put in place a policy for Related Party Transactions approved by the Board.
